scope: Local diagnosis and correction of historical PR #106 native-qualification failures

fast_build_options.historical_failure: Tests-on / dwg2dxf-off CMake generation referenced the missing dwg2dxf target.
fast_build_options.current_check: The same configuration succeeds on the current clean source checkout.
fast_build_options.disposition: Not reproducible on the current candidate.

linux_type_limits.historical_failure: GCC 13 rejected oType <= 0x7FFF in DRW_Table::getDwgClassNum because oType is int16_t and the upper-bound comparison is always true.
linux_type_limits.current_source: getDwgClassNum checks the meaningful lower bound only; the historical upper-bound comparison is absent.
linux_type_limits.local_build: The current dxfrw library builds with AppleClang and -Werror. No GCC 13 toolchain is installed locally.
linux_type_limits.disposition: Current source no longer contains the reported comparison; exact GCC 13 qualification remains for hosted CI.

windows_lambda_capture.historical_failure: MSVC C3493 rejected countMask, grouped, and sawOptional references inside the LWPOLYLINE vertexForField lambda; later C2064/C2737/C3536 diagnostics were cascades.
windows_lambda_capture.fix: Moved the masks to anonymous-namespace constexpr constants so the lambda uses namespace-scope values without captures.
windows_lambda_capture.focused_validation: PASS: libdxfrw_dxf_lwpoly_wcs_vertices built and its focused CTest passed 1/1 under AppleClang.
windows_lambda_capture.disposition: The diagnosed source issue is fixed; MSVC hosted confirmation remains open.

macos_inventory.historical_log: The old macOS job reported that live CTest inventory differed from the frozen broad inventory; the log did not print the names.

current_clean_checkout.profile: Ninja, clang/clang++, Release, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF, docs=OFF, dwg2dxf=ON, tests=ON, qualification=OFF, long_fuzz=OFF

macos_inventory.fix: Regenerated metadata/qualification-required-tests-v1.json with tools/run_native_qualification.py freeze-inventory at the current source commit.
macos_inventory.validation: PASS: exact hosted-profile CTest names match the regenerated 1386-name manifest; tools/check_qualification_workflow.py passes.
macos_inventory.disposition: The current inventory is internally aligned. The archived old-run artifact names were not independently extracted, so no claim is made that its specific delta was identical.
